eyebrow.zh: 本地优先 · 一句话问答 · 答案带出处 · 开源 MIT
eyebrow.en: Local first · Ask in one line · Answers with receipts · Open source MIT

headline.zh: 把散落的账单、流水与笔记拼成一张能问答的图
headline.en: Fuse your scattered bills, statements and notes into a graph you can query

sub.zh: 把微信里的「小张」、支付宝备注的「张三」和银行流水里的「张*」认成同一个人，然后用一句话问回你的数据。
sub.en: It recognizes the "小张" in WeChat, the "张三" in an Alipay remark and the "张*" in your bank statement as the same person — then lets you ask your data a single question.

hero.command: minekg ingest examples/exports && minekg link && minekg ask "去年和小张相关的所有资金往来合计"

cta.zh: 10 分钟从 git clone 到带凭证的答案。本地优先，MIT 开源。
cta.en: 10 minutes from git clone to a receipt-backed answer. Local first, MIT open source.

title.zh: 把散落的导出拼成一张图
title.en: Stitch scattered exports into one graph

body.zh: 微信聊天记录、支付宝账单、银行流水 PDF、个人笔记——丢进同一个目录，自动识别来源，融合成一份每条都带出处的记录。
body.en: WeChat chats, Alipay bills, bank-statement PDFs, personal notes — drop them in one folder; each source is auto-detected and fused into one record set where every row keeps its origin.

chips: › 微信 / 支付宝 / 银行 / 笔记

title.zh: 把「小张」「张三」「张*」认成同一个人
title.en: See "小张", "张三" and "张*" as one person

body.zh: 微信里的「小张」、支付宝备注的「张三」、银行流水里的「张*」——都归到同一个人，跨来源对账不再靠人脑拼。
body.en: The "小张" in WeChat, the "张三" in an Alipay remark, the "张*" in a bank statement — all resolve to one person, so cross-source reconciliation stops being a mental puzzle.

title.zh: 一句话问回，答案带出处
title.en: Ask in one line, get answers with receipts

body.zh: 「去年和小张相关的所有资金往来合计」——直接返回数字，并附逐行出处表：哪条来源、哪一行、哪个人。
body.en: "All money moved with 小张 last year" — you get a number plus a per-row receipt: which source, which row, which person.

chips: › 合计 / 笔数 / 平均

title.en: Your bills never leave your machine

body.zh: 原始导出文件留在本机，只有短文本片段会出去做识别；图也存在你自己拥有的一个本地文件里。
body.en: Raw export files stay on your machine — only short text snippets leave for recognition — and the graph lives in a single local file you own.

headline.zh: 10 分钟，从 git clone 到带凭证的答案
headline.en: 10 minutes from git clone to a receipt-backed answer

sub.zh: 本地优先，永久免费；MIT 开源——欢迎报 bug 或附上一份匿名真实多源导出来复现。
sub.en: Local first and free forever; MIT open source — file a bug, or attach an anonymized real multi-source export to reproduce.

tag.en: MineKG — local first, turning your scattered bills into a graph you can ask. MIT open source.
